intent: Reuse CAP-0001 and CAP-0002 to preserve and ground a primary-source HBM3E status packet for Micron, SK hynix and Samsung while keeping development, sampling, volume production, customer supply/shipment and platform shipment/qualification as distinct claim states. This phase stops at Grounded Evidence and does not infer customer qualification from product announcements or third-party reporting.
rationale: The HBM3E sources are new material for the existing memory campaign. CAP-0001 already owns truthful content-verified readable representations and CAP-0002 already owns exact claim-scoped JSON-pointer grounding. The discovered statements can be preserved without introducing semiconductor-specific state semantics; any later Reality/Judgment/Outcome promotion must be admitted separately after the fragments exist.
